title: Vox: the first call, then the history of calls

screens.title: 1 · Before the first call
screens.why: The empty home is an invitation: the agent's presence, one question, one button.

pins.label: The presence
pins.text: AppPresence, the dot from the mark, as the hero: the same thing the person will talk to in the call. No illustration, no sparkle.

pins.label: O que te traz aqui?
pins.text: Seven goal chips (new AppChoiceChip), each with a Phosphor glyph: presentationChart, briefcase, usersThree, chalkboardTeacher, microphoneStage, wind, dotsThree. Optional: the button works without a pick.

pins.label: The one CTA
pins.text: Fazer minha primeira ligação: the accent, full width, pinned to the thumb. Same phone glyph as every call button.

pins.label: Writing moves up
pins.text: Prefiro escrever leaves the body: the chat is the chat icon in the top bar, beside sign out. One accent action per screen.

pins.label: Sets expectations
pins.text: Uns três minutos · só você e o Vox: how long, and that nobody else listens.

screens.title: 2 · A goal picked
screens.why: Picking says what the first call will be about, so the button has a promise behind it.

pins.label: Selected
pins.text: The picked chip turns accentSoft with a teal edge and glyph; no check mark. One goal at a time, changeable.

pins.label: The plan
pins.text: One line per goal on what the first call does (here, present a work topic in a minute). The goal goes to the server and opens the first call.

screens.title: 3 · After the first call
screens.why: The first call lands at the top of the home; the call-out says where it is and invites the second.

pins.label: Call-out
pins.text: AppCard on accentSoft: Primeira ligação feita, and the promise that Vox remembers. Começar ligação stays the one accent button.

pins.label: Nova
pins.text: A teal badge until the call is opened.

pins.label: Totals
pins.text: How many calls and the time spent together, under Suas ligações.

pins.label: First learning
pins.text: The card leads with the date, the subject the agent named and two lines of summary, then the first learning behind a lightbulb (Phosphor).

pins.label: Time and money
pins.text: clock: minutes; coins: US$ with a Brazilian comma, what the call cost in Deepgram + model.

screens.title: 4 · The history
screens.why: Every call, newest first; the call-out carries the last lesson into the next call.

pins.label: Da última vez
pins.text: Once there is a history, the call-out quotes the last call's first learning: the reason to call again.

pins.label: Follow-up
pins.text: arrowBendDownRight + 2ª do assunto: this call continued an earlier one, with its memory.

pins.label: Opens
pins.text: The whole card is the tap target (caret right); it opens /ligacoes/:id.

screens.title: 5 · A call, opened
screens.why: The summary and what to take from it, and one button to keep going on the same subject.

pins.label: Facts
pins.text: Duration to the second, cost, and the subject index, as pills (AppMeta boxed). Date above the serif title.

pins.label: O que levar daqui
pins.text: The learnings, numbered in teal circles, most important first.

pins.label: Continuar este assunto
pins.text: The page's one button, pinned: a new call that gets this call's summary, learnings and numbers, so memory accumulates. The line above says so.

screens.title: 6 · Its numbers
screens.why: The numbers measured in code, against the first call on the subject.

pins.label: Three tiles
pins.text: Pace (gauge), long pauses (pause), hesitations (waveform): what speech-metrics.ts already measures.

pins.label: Since the 1ª
pins.text: Each number's change since the subject's first call. Only fewer hesitations turns green: pace and pauses have no good direction on their own.
